source.menu_pricing_note: Menu pricing is valid for Torrance only.

branding.note: Display alias only. Prices, items, and source URLs are real and retained for provenance.
branding.ui_usage: Use display_name in the app, demo, and slides. Keep source.business_name out of the UI.

notes: Prices and serving sizes are transcribed from the public Torrance catering menu captured 2026-10-18.
GF on the source menu means gluten-sensitive, not certified gluten-free. No item is represented as gluten-free.
Allergens are transcribed from the source allergen table where an item matched. Unmatched items are marked unknown, never none.
Package and boxed-meal allergens depend on the selections made and must be confirmed by the caterer.

dietary_tag_definitions.vegan: Source menu marks the item V.
dietary_tag_definitions.vegetarian: Source menu marks the item VT.
dietary_tag_definitions.gluten_sensitive: Source menu marks the item GF. This is not a gluten-free certification.
